Class LandShape

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.map.LandShape
All Implemented Interfaces:
Shape
public final class LandShape extends Object implements Shape
Fills the bundled landmasses, giving a land/sea shading to pair with CoastlineShape.

The fill is derived from the same bundled coastline: each coastline feature is treated as a ring and filled, closing it implicitly from its last point back to its first. Continents that Natural Earth splits at the antimeridian close along the dateline, which can leave a small fill artifact at the very edge of a whole-world view. Draw it below the coastline. This shape never clears the canvas and adds no dependencies or data beyond the bundled coastline. 

ctx.draw(new LandShape(Color.rgb(0, 40, 0)));   // dark green land
ctx.draw(new CoastlineShape(Color.CYAN));        // coastline on top
